dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Embora o trabalho remoto possa aumentar a produtividade, nem todos conseguem manter o foco em casa.
dialogue.translation: Although remote work can increase productivity, not everyone manages to stay focused at home.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Concordo, mas o maior benefício é a flexibilidade: posso organizar o meu dia conforme as minhas necessidades.
dialogue.translation: I agree, but the biggest advantage is flexibility: I can organize my day according to my needs.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No entanto, uma grande desvantagem é o isolamento social, que pode afetar a saúde mental a longo prazo.
dialogue.translation: However, a major disadvantage is social isolation, which can affect mental health in the long term.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Isso é verdade, mas muitas empresas oferecem ferramentas através de plataformas digitais para manter a comunicação.
dialogue.translation: That is true, but many companies offer tools through digital platforms to maintain communication.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ainda assim, trabalhar em casa pode exigir mais autodisciplina do que muitos imaginam.
dialogue.translation: Even so, working from home can require more self-discipline than many imagine.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, e por isso é importante definir metas claras; portanto, conseguimos alcançar bons resultados sem perder o equilíbrio.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and that is why it is important to set clear goals; therefore, we can achieve good results without losing balance.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sou favorável ao trabalho híbrido, pois combina o melhor dos dois mundos.
dialogue.translation: I am in favor of hybrid work, as it combines the best of both worlds.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Também acho que essa é a solução mais equilibrada para a maioria das equipas.
dialogue.translation: I also think that is the most balanced solution for most teams.

key_phrases.translation: to be in favor of something

scenario: Discussing a complex ethical dilemma
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Portuguese

often plural 'consequências'
can mean both guilt and blame
context-dependent: 'consciência' as moral conscience

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cada decisão aqui tem uma consequência que não podemos evitar.
dialogue.translation: Every decision here has a consequence that we cannot avoid.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Pois é, mas eu não quero carregar a culpa de prejudicar alguém, mesmo que seja para o bem maior.
dialogue.translation: That's true, but I don't want to carry the guilt of harming someone, even if it's for the greater good.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Entendo, mas a tua consciência vai ficar tranquila se souberes que agiste de forma justa?
dialogue.translation: I understand, but will your conscience be at peace if you know you acted fairly?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Não sei, talvez seja melhor não julgar tão depressa, aliás, cada caso é único.
dialogue.translation: I don't know, maybe it's better not to judge so quickly; besides, each case is unique.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mas não podemos permitir que o medo nos paralise, senão nunca agiremos moralmente.
dialogue.translation: But we cannot allow fear to paralyze us, otherwise we will never act morally.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Concordo, mas a tua solução parece-me moralmente ambígua, e isso pesa na consciência.
dialogue.translation: I agree, but your solution seems morally ambiguous to me, and that weighs on the conscience.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Talvez seja, mas a alternativa seria pior, e a culpa seria ainda maior.
dialogue.translation: Maybe it is, but the alternative would be worse, and the guilt would be even greater.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Então, no fim, temos de escolher a opção com menos consequências negativas, mesmo que não seja perfeita.
dialogue.translation: So, in the end, we have to choose the option with the fewest negative consequences, even if it's not perfect.

scenario: Analyzing the impact of social media on society
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Portuguese

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você já pensou no efeito que as redes sociais têm na nossa opinião?
dialogue.translation: Have you ever thought about the effect that social networks have on our opinion?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, mas acho que depende muito do tipo de informação que cada usuário consome.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but I think it depends a lot on the type of information each user consumes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E você acha que elas influenciam o comportamento das pessoas apesar de a maioria negar?
dialogue.translation: And do you think they influence people's behavior even though most deny it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Com certeza. Muita gente compartilha notícias sem verificar a fonte, e isso afeta a percepção pública.
dialogue.translation: Definitely. Many people share news without checking the source, and that affects public perception.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mas também há o lado positivo: elas dão voz a quem não tinha espaço público antes.
dialogue.translation: But there is also a positive side: they give a voice to those who previously had no public space.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Verdade, mas a falta de privacidade é um preço alto. Muitos usuários nem percebem o quanto expõem.
dialogue.translation: True, but the lack of privacy is a high price. Many users don't even realize how much they expose.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Então, no fim, tudo depende do uso que fazemos. A ferramenta em si não é boa nem má.
dialogue.translation: So, in the end, everything depends on how we use it. The tool itself is neither good nor bad.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exato. Mas é preciso exigir mais transparência das empresas, porque a influência é enorme.
dialogue.translation: Exactly. But we must demand more transparency from companies, because the influence is enormous.

key_phrases.translation: give a voice to those who had no space

dialogue.translation: I understand, and maybe I am also starting to appreciate this idea of living more calmly.

dialogue.text: Obrigado pela proposta. Antes de aceitar, gostaria de discutir algumas condições do contrato.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Maybe. But I also want to demand an extra benefit: one day of remote work per week.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: That is an advantage for you, but it complicates the team dynamics. Can we agree on every two weeks?

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: With every two weeks, I would be more satisfied if the package also included a fixed performance bonus.

dialogue.speaker: B

scenario: Debating environmental policy with a peer

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Achas que a nova política ambiental do governo vai reduzir as emissões?
dialogue.translation: Do you think the government's new environmental policy will reduce emissions?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Embora seja uma medida importante, acho que é necessário aumentar os impostos para ter efeito real.
dialogue.translation: Although it is an important measure, I think it is necessary to increase taxes to have a real effect.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Entretanto, uma nova lei sozinha não basta; é preciso investir em transportes públicos. Portanto, devemos pressionar o governo.
dialogue.translation: However, a new law alone is not enough; we must invest in public transportation. Therefore, we should pressure the government.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Concordo, mas é possível que os custos aumentem para os cidadãos. Como podemos evitar isso?
dialogue.translation: I agree, but it is possible that costs will increase for citizens. How can we avoid that?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Através de subsídios para energias renováveis, podemos reduzir a dependência de combustíveis fósseis.
dialogue.translation: Through subsidies for renewable energy, we can reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Entretanto, nem todos os países têm os mesmos recursos. Portanto, precisamos de uma abordagem global.
dialogue.translation: However, not all countries have the same resources. Therefore, we need a global approach.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, mas sem uma lei forte, as empresas não vão mudar. É necessário agir já.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but without a strong law, companies will not change. It is necessary to act now.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Embora concorde, acho que devemos discutir mais antes de tomar uma medida tão drástica.
dialogue.translation: Although I agree, I think we should discuss more before taking such a drastic measure.

scenario: Discussing immigration and identity

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Quando decidiste mudar para a Alemanha, tinhas medo de te sentires diferente?
dialogue.translation: When you decided to move to Germany, were you afraid of feeling different?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No início, sim. Eu cresci com a cultura portuguesa em casa, mas aqui tudo era tão diferente da minha origem.
dialogue.translation: At first, yes. I grew up with Portuguese culture at home, but here everything was so different from my origin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E como é que lidas com essa dupla identidade? Sentes que pertences a algum país?
dialogue.translation: And how do you deal with this dual identity? Do you feel you belong to any country?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A minha identidade é algo que tive de aceitar com o tempo. Apesar de viver aqui, a minha raiz é de lá.
dialogue.translation: My identity is something I had to accept over time. Despite living here, my roots are there.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mas sentes que essa mistura afeta a tua relação com a geração mais jovem da tua família?
dialogue.translation: But do you feel that this mix affects your relationship with the younger generation of your family?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, os meus filhos já não sentem a mesma ligação ao meu país de origem. Eles já se sentem totalmente alemães.
dialogue.translation: Yes, my children no longer feel the same connection to my country of origin. They already feel completely German.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E o que é que fazes para eles conhecerem o teu próprio contexto familiar?
dialogue.translation: And what do you do so they get to know your own family context?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Passamos férias em Portugal todos os anos, mas apesar de isso, sei que a identidade deles vai ser sempre diferente da minha.
dialogue.translation: We spend holidays in Portugal every year, but despite that, I know their identity will always be different from mine.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Ah, yes! This specific image completely changes my perception of the work.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: É um elemento significativo, sem dúvida. Talvez seja a chave para toda a composição.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E sem igualdade perante a lei, a justiça social é difícil de alcançar.
dialogue.translation: And without equality before the law, social justice is difficult to achieve.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Concordo. Um partido que promete transformar a sociedade precisa de apoio popular.
dialogue.translation: I agree. A party that promises to transform society needs popular support.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mas cuidado: nem todos os partidos realmente respeitam a vontade do povo.
dialogue.translation: But be careful: not all parties truly respect the will of the people.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Por isso, é essencial que cada cidadão exerça o seu direito de voto.
dialogue.translation: Therefore, it is essential that every citizen exercises their right to vote.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E que os representantes eleitos sejam responsáveis perante a justiça.
dialogue.translation: And that elected representatives are accountable to justice.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exato. Só assim a democracia pode evoluir e garantir mais igualdade.
dialogue.translation: Exactly. Only then can democracy evolve and guarantee more equality.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: First, we need to understand the entire process before starting.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Yes, but each stage has a specific function that we must check.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: But this analysis allows identifying possible errors in the process.

dialogue.translation: Yes, and then we can adjust each parameter before the next stage.

dialogue.speaker: B

scenario: Discussing the ethics of AI
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: feminine noun; frequently used in abstract contexts
feminine noun; often used with 'ter' or 'assumir'
invariable in gender; can also be a noun (the moral)
masculine form; feminine 'ética'
regular -ar verb; often followed by infinitive
regular -ar verb; transitive
takes preposition 'em'
masculine noun; plural 'algoritmos'
feminine noun; common in tech discussions
feminine noun
prepositional phrase; requires 'de' + noun
used to introduce a conclusion

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Acho que a inteligência artificial pode tomar decisões importantes, mas quem é responsável por elas?
dialogue.translation: I think artificial intelligence can make important decisions, but who is responsible for them?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exatamente, a responsabilidade é uma questão ética central. Muitas vezes os algoritmos agem sem transparência.
dialogue.translation: Exactly, responsibility is a central ethical issue. Often algorithms act without transparency.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mas podemos confiar neles se não entendemos como chegam a uma conclusão?
dialogue.translation: But can we trust them if we don't understand how they reach a conclusion?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Devemos evitar que a IA prejudique grupos vulneráveis, por exemplo através de vieses nos dados.
dialogue.translation: We must avoid AI harming vulnerable groups, for example through biases in the data.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, a privacidade também é um risco. Portanto, precisamos de regras claras.
dialogue.translation: Yes, privacy is also a risk. Therefore, we need clear rules.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Concordo. Uma decisão moral não pode ser apenas programada; ela exige julgamento humano.
dialogue.translation: I agree. A moral decision cannot just be programmed; it requires human judgment.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Então, quem deve ser responsável se um algoritmo causar dano?
dialogue.translation: So, who should be responsible if an algorithm causes harm?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Talvez a empresa que o criou, mas também o governo que permitiu seu uso. Não é simples.
dialogue.translation: Perhaps the company that created it, but also the government that allowed its use. It's not simple.

scenario: Talking about gender roles and change
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: here: social role

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você já reparou como o papel de cada pessoa na sociedade mudou nas últimas décadas?
dialogue.translation: Have you noticed how the role of each person in society has changed in recent decades?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, a mudança é enorme, mas ainda há muita resistência, principalmente em relação à educação das crianças.
dialogue.translation: Yes, the change is enormous, but there is still a lot of resistance, especially regarding the upbringing of children.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Concordo. Acho que a educação atual ainda reforça comportamentos tradicionais, quase sem questioná-los.
dialogue.translation: I agree. I think current education still reinforces traditional behaviors, almost without questioning them.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Talvez seja por isso que muitos homens ainda não aceitam dividir as tarefas domésticas de forma justa.
dialogue.translation: Maybe that's why many men still don't accept sharing household chores fairly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pois é, mas acho que criar os filhos com mais igualdade pode ajudar a mudar esse cenário.
dialogue.translation: Exactly, but I think raising children with more equality can help change this scenario.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, e também precisamos discutir abertamente essas questões, enquanto houver preconceito.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and we also need to openly discuss these issues as long as there is prejudice.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exato. Enquanto não mudarmos nossa mentalidade, a igualdade plena vai demorar.
dialogue.translation: Exactly. As long as we don't change our mindset, full equality will take time.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Pelo menos, já vejo quase todos os meus amigos participando mais em casa. É um começo.
dialogue.translation: At least, I already see almost all my friends participating more at home. It's a start.

key_phrases.translation: the role of each person in society

scenario: Reflecting on a life-changing experience
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Reflexive 'sentir-se' means 'to feel' (as in emotional state)
Also in a figurative sense: 'to grow from something'
Often with 'de' + noun: 'mudar de vida'
Impersonal: 'acontece que...' = 'it happens that...'
With 'de': 'lembrar-se de algo'
Commonly with 'naquele momento' = 'at that moment'
Metaphorical: 'de coração' = 'from the heart'
Very frequent; 'a minha vida' = 'my life'
With 'de': 'diferente de' = 'different from'
As adverb: 'junto com' = 'together with'
With 'de': 'depois de' = 'after'
Temporal: 'quando eu era' = 'when I was'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Quando olho para trás, sinto que aquele momento mudou completamente a minha vida.
dialogue.translation: When I look back, I feel that that moment completely changed my life.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: O que aconteceu exatamente? Lembras-te bem desse dia?
dialogue.translation: What exactly happened? Do you remember that day well?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Aconteceu tudo tão rápido que, no início, nem percebi. Mas depois, quando pensei melhor, vi que era diferente de tudo o que tinha vivido.
dialogue.translation: Everything happened so quickly that at first I didn't even notice. But later, when I thought more carefully, I saw that it was different from everything I had experienced.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: E como te sentiste naquele momento? Foi difícil crescer com essa experiência?
dialogue.translation: And how did you feel at that moment? Was it difficult to grow with that experience?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No coração, foi assustador. Mas sentir o apoio das pessoas que estavam junto a mim fez toda a diferença.
dialogue.translation: In my heart, it was frightening. But feeling the support of the people who were by my side made all the difference.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: E depois dessa experiência, o que mudou na tua maneira de ver a vida?
dialogue.translation: And after that experience, what changed in your way of seeing life?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tudo! Agora sei que cada momento é único e que não devemos esperar pelo momento perfeito para agir.
dialogue.translation: Everything! Now I know that every moment is unique and that we shouldn't wait for the perfect moment to act.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: É verdade. Quando aprendemos isso, sentimos que crescemos de verdade. E lembrar disso todos os dias é o que nos mantém fortes.
dialogue.translation: That's true. When we learn this, we feel that we truly grow. And remembering that every day is what keeps us strong.

scenario: Discussing the role of humor in communication
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Common in fixed expressions like 'rir de' (to laugh at)
Also in the expression 'ter graça' (to be funny)
Opposite of 'engraçado'
Describes people or situations
Specifically a joke that you tell
Also used as 'bom humor' (good mood)
Can be misunderstood
Figuratively 'not serious'
In the expression 'fazer sentido' (to make sense)
Often in the imperative: 'Brinca!' = 'That's a joke!'
Common in everyday conversations
Emphasizes the comical effect

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você já notou como o humor pode tornar uma conversa muito mais leve?
dialogue.translation: Have you noticed how humor can make a conversation much lighter?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, mas é preciso ter cuidado: uma piada fora de hora pode ser interpretada como falta de respeito, não como algo engraçado.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but you have to be careful: a joke at the wrong time can be interpreted as disrespect, not as something funny.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Concordo. A ironia, por exemplo, exige que o ouvinte entenda o sentido real da mensagem para não ficar ofendido.
dialogue.translation: I agree. Irony, for example, requires the listener to understand the real meaning of the message in order not to be offended.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: E quando alguém brinca com um assunto sério, pode parecer que não leva o problema a sério, mesmo que a intenção seja só descontrair.
dialogue.translation: And when someone jokes about a serious topic, it can seem like they don't take the problem seriously, even if the intention is just to lighten the mood.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Por outro lado, rir juntos fortalece os laços e mostra que podemos falar sobre quase tudo, desde que haja confiança.
dialogue.translation: On the other hand, laughing together strengthens bonds and shows that we can talk about almost anything, as long as there is trust.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Acho que o bom humor é uma ferramenta social poderosa, mas o timing é tudo; um comentário cômico no momento errado pode causar mal-entendidos.
dialogue.translation: I think good humor is a powerful social tool, but timing is everything; a comic comment at the wrong moment can cause misunderstandings.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Então, como saber se uma graça vai funcionar? Talvez observar a reação da outra pessoa seja a chave.
dialogue.translation: So, how do we know if a joke will work? Maybe observing the other person's reaction is the key.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, e se a pessoa não rir, o melhor é não insistir e voltar ao assunto com seriedade.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and if the person doesn't laugh, the best thing is not to insist and to return to the subject seriously.

scenario: Presenting a research finding

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Apresento agora os resultados da nossa análise.
dialogue.translation: I now present the results of our analysis.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Qual foi o tamanho da amostra que vocês usaram?
dialogue.translation: What was the size of the sample you used?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usamos 200 participantes e comparamos os dados antes e depois da intervenção.
dialogue.translation: We used 200 participants and compared the data before and after the intervention.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: E o que vocês observaram como resultado principal?
dialogue.translation: And what did you observe as the main result?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Observamos uma melhora significativa, o que indica que a intervenção é eficaz.
dialogue.translation: We observed a significant improvement, which indicates that the intervention is effective.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Entretanto, vocês têm evidência suficiente para essa conclusão?
dialogue.translation: However, do you have sufficient evidence for this conclusion?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, a partir de nossos dados e segundo a literatura, a evidência é forte.
dialogue.translation: Yes, based on our data and according to the literature, the evidence is strong.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Portanto, podemos considerar o resultado válido.
dialogue.translation: Therefore, we can consider the result valid.

scenario: Discussing inequality and social mobility
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Common in social contexts

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Você já reparou como a desigualdade de renda afeta a mobilidade social no nosso país?
dialogue.translation: Have you noticed how income inequality affects social mobility in our country?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, e o pior é que muitas pessoas não têm acesso a boas escolas, o que dificulta melhorar de vida.
dialogue.translation: Yes, and the worst part is that many people don't have access to good schools, which makes it difficult to improve their lives.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Apesar de todos os programas sociais, acho que ainda falta muito para superar essa barreira.
dialogue.translation: Despite all the social programs, I think there is still a lot missing to overcome this barrier.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Embora alguns consigam subir, a maioria não tem as mesmas oportunidades desde o início.
dialogue.translation: Although some manage to rise, most don't have the same opportunities from the start.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E você acha que o governo deveria aumentar os investimentos em educação?
dialogue.translation: And do you think the government should increase investments in education?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Claro, mas também é preciso que as pessoas se esforcem e mereçam essas chances.
dialogue.translation: Of course, but it's also necessary for people to make an effort and deserve these chances.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Concordo, apesar disso, a sorte também tem um papel importante, não acha?
dialogue.translation: I agree, nevertheless, luck also plays an important role, don't you think?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, mas não podemos esquecer que a base estrutural é fundamental para dar oportunidades a todos.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but we can't forget that the structural foundation is essential to give opportunities to everyone.

scenario: Talking about leadership styles
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of Portuguese

vocabulary.note: Feminine noun, commonly used in professional contexts.
Often used with 'tomar' (to make a decision).
As noun, means 'goal'; as adjective, 'objective'.
Used with 'ter' or 'depositar'.
Means to guide or direct someone.
Regular -ar verb, often used with 'equipe'.
Stronger than 'pedir' – implies requirement.
Invariable in gender, commonly used for people and plans.
Often has negative connotation in leadership context.
Describes a style that involves team members.
Frequency adverb, equivalent to 'usually'.
Compound preposition, often used for means or method.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Para orientar uma equipe de forma eficaz, geralmente é preciso equilibrar autoridade e confiança.
dialogue.translation: To guide a team effectively, one usually needs to balance authority and trust.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Concordo, mas um líder autoritário costuma exigir obediência sem dar espaço para opiniões.
dialogue.translation: I agree, but an authoritarian leader often demands obedience without leaving room for opinions.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Já o estilo participativo busca envolver todos na tomada de decisão, o que aumenta o compromisso.
dialogue.translation: The participative style, on the other hand, seeks to involve everyone in decision-making, which increases commitment.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Isso funciona bem, mas pode tornar o processo mais lento, especialmente quando há um objetivo claro.
dialogue.translation: That works well, but it can make the process slower, especially when there is a clear goal.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Para motivar a equipe, muitos líderes adotam uma abordagem flexível, adaptando-se às necessidades do grupo.
dialogue.translation: To motivate the team, many leaders adopt a flexible approach, adapting to the group's needs.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: E você acha que é possível alcançar bons resultados através de um diálogo aberto?
dialogue.translation: And do you think it is possible to achieve good results through open dialogue?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sim, desde que o líder saiba quando decidir sozinho e quando delegar, sempre com transparência.
dialogue.translation: Yes, as long as the leader knows when to decide alone and when to delegate, always with transparency.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Então, na prática, não existe um estilo único – cada situação exige uma combinação diferente.
dialogue.translation: So, in practice, there is no single style – each situation requires a different combination.
